answer: The ridge book no longer lists an observer post from a desk sketch. I carry a 2.1-kg onyx prism to peg 17 on the published knoll, hang a 7-watt lantern 1.6 m above the pin, and stream a 22-second return flash from a 310 m baseline, locking 24 POA for 5 epochs. Three surveyors recompute the flash interval in 0.9 s and accept only if all three match an 8 ms window and a 0.4-degree bearing. A reused prism serial, or two streams sharing 20 of 22 timestamps, drops 13 POA and shelves that key for 4 epochs. Thirty-nine cloned keys would freeze 936 POA with nothing on the hill.
